rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for giving up, abandoning, or retiring from something such as a title or position.

example.english: I decided to relinquish the position.
example.jyutping: ngo5 kyut3 ding6 fong3 hei3 go3 zik1 wai6

rows.note: Use this for physically letting go or releasing something you are holding.

example.english: You'd better relinquish your grip, or the rope will break.
example.traditional: 你快啲放手，條繩就斷喇！
example.jyutping: nei5 faai3 di1 fong3 sau2 tiu4 sing4 zau6 tyun5 laa3

rows.note: Use this when someone actively hands over possession, authority, or control to someone else.

example.english: They ultimately had to relinquish control to the new captain.
example.traditional: 佢哋最後都要交出控制權，畀新隊長帶隊。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zeoi3 hau6 dou1 jiu3 gaau1 ceot1 hung3 zai3 kyun4 bei2 san1 deoi6 zoeng2 daai2 deoi6
